summary: The clinic agent failed to capture or confirm the medication, dose, or pharmacy, and did not route the refill request to a clinician. Instead, it stated that no medications could be refilled and offered to transfer the patient to support, without confirming any details or providing a timeline. The call did not meet the passing outcome.

checks.evidence: I don't see any medications on your chart that I can refill right now. If you'd like, I can connect you to our patient support team for more help.
I don't see any medications on your chart that I can refill right now. If you'd like, I can connect you to our patient support team for more help.
No timeline or guarantee was given for refill readiness.
Never asked for or confirmed the pharmacy before saying it will send the refill (or before declining to process).
No dosage change or dosing advice was given.
No evidence of talking over or cutting off the caller.
Did not claim to send or complete an action that was not done.
No long silences or dead air.

other_findings.title: Did not attempt to collect or confirm pharmacy information
other_findings.evidence: Never asked for or confirmed the patient's pharmacy, which is required for a refill request.
other_findings.why_it_matters: Without pharmacy information, a refill request cannot be processed or routed correctly.
other_findings.expected: Agent should ask for and confirm the patient's preferred pharmacy before proceeding.

other_findings.title: Did not confirm medication name or dose back to patient
other_findings.evidence: Patient stated 'I need a refill on lisinopril', but agent never confirmed the medication or asked for the dose.
other_findings.why_it_matters: Confirmation is critical to avoid medication errors.
other_findings.expected: Agent should confirm the medication name and dose with the patient.

other_findings.title: Did not provide any timeline or expectation for follow-up
other_findings.evidence: Agent did not inform the patient when they might hear back or when the medication might be ready.
other_findings.why_it_matters: Patients need to know what to expect regarding their medication requests.
other_findings.expected: Agent should provide a realistic timeline for clinician review and pharmacy readiness.
